CBSE • CLASS 10 • COMPUTER APPLICATIONS

Unit I · Networking

15 marks. Internet basics, internet services, mobile technology and the vocabulary of how networks are built.

  • Ch 1 · Internet BasicsWhat the internet is, how it started and what it is built out of.
  • Ch 2 · Internet Services & ProtocolsWWW, email, FTP, chat — and the protocol behind each one.
  • Ch 3 · Network Types, Topologies & DevicesLAN to WAN, star to ring, and the boxes in between.
  • Ch 4 · Mobile & Wireless TechnologyGenerations from 1G to 5G, plus the short-range wireless around you.
  • Ch 5 · Web Browsers, Search & Web ConceptsBrowsers, search engines, cookies, caching and the difference between a web page and a website.
  • टोपोलॉजी, प्रोटोकॉल और नेटवर्किंग उपकरण — तीनों की परिभाषाएँ शब्दशः याद रखें।
